title: Elementor #2771
content:
Maia Mitšulis

The first certified PCM trainer in Estonia

Understand people better.
Communicate more effectively.
Navigate stress with more clarity.

Different people can hear the same words, react to the same situation and need very different things in order to stay engaged. I help leaders, teams and individuals understand these differences and turn them into more effective communication, stronger collaboration and less unnecessary tension.

Explore how we can work together

Does this sound familiar?

Communication can become difficult long before anyone calls it a communication problem.

01

You say the same thing to two people — and get completely different reactions.

02

You explain something clearly, but later realise it was understood differently.

03

A conversation that should be simple suddenly becomes tense, confusing or exhausting.

04

Under stress, someone familiar starts communicating in a way that feels completely unlike them.

These situations are often easier to navigate once you understand what different people pay attention to, what keeps them engaged and how their communication changes under stress.
